In the transition zone, plant major-season maize from mid-March to end of April (MoFA). In the transition zone, plant major-season maize from end of March to end of April (IITA). In the transition zone, plant minor-season maize from mid July through August to early Sept. (MoFA). In the transition zone, plant minor-season maize from mid of July to early September (IITA). It is recommended to plant after three good rains within the planting window to ensure enough soil moisture to support germination and early growth. Your extension officer will confirm which to follow.
